plugin.name: Scripts
plugin.description: Write JavaScript that works across your project's repositories, and run it from keys, gestures, Multi Actions and workflows. Each script runs in a sandbox and can do only what you granted it.

permissions.scripts: Runs your scripts in a sandbox. A script reaches files, programs or a shell only through the permissions you grant that script on its Permissions tab; a new or imported script has none.
permissions.hostViews: Shows DeckPilot's own Scripts screen and its entry in the navigation.

run.name: Run script
run.description: Runs one of your saved scripts.

check.name: Check script
check.description: Checks a script for syntax errors without running it.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: Optional JSON the script reads as deckpilot.run.inputs.
